name: Legendary Wind Howler Bracers
binding_raw: Bound to Account on Acquire , Exclusive

effects.name: Greater Marksmanship
effects.tooltip: Greater Marksmanship : This item is enchanted to enhance your skill with ranged weapons. You gain a +3 Competence Bonus to Ranged Attack and a +2 Competence Bonus to Ranged Damage.

effects.name: Insightful Doubleshot
effects.tooltip: Insightful Doubleshot 5% : Passive: 5% Insight bonus to Doubleshot. (Doubleshot is a chance to score an additional hit with a ranged attack.)

effects.name: Wind Through The Trees
effects.tooltip: Feat : Wind Through The Trees : When enemies hit or miss you, they have a 5% chance to be knocked down with no save. This may only trigger once every 12 seconds, and shares a cooldown with the Wind through the Trees feat.

effects.name: Greater Shrieking Bolt
effects.tooltip: Greater Shrieking Bolt : This item resonates with sonic energy. On ranged attacks, on an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit it will punish the target with a blast of sound (20 to 120 sonic damage).

effects.name: Deception
effects.tooltip: Deception +11 : +11 Enhancement bonus to hit and +17 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

flavor_text: These bracers were once worn by a harpy of the dangerous and elite Wind Howler flight. They dramatically increase the wearer's aptitude with ranged weaponry.
